name: John Ugbe
headline: I build thoughtful products and reliable systems.
summary: Over 8 years building and shipping software across web, mobile, fintech, AI, and streaming. I work closely with teams to understand product goals, refine requirements, navigate technical complexity, and deliver software that serves real business needs.
bio:
I work at the intersection of product thinking and software engineering, turning ideas into practical solutions. My experience spans financial platforms, streaming, mobile applications, and AI-powered products. I'm particularly interested in agentic systems, developer tooling, and how emerging technologies can reshape the way software is built and used.

I enjoy working across the product lifecycle, from understanding the problem and shaping requirements to making architectural decisions and delivering reliable systems.

paragraphs: That breadth includes building the client application for Reka AI, integrating Python model fine-tuning APIs and streaming conversations. My independent projects explore related engineering questions: AgentVault is an experimental MCP gateway and permission broker for scoped tool access and auditability; DevMirror connects GitHub OAuth, repository data, and pull request analysis to developer contribution insights. DevBrief explores AI-integrated developer tooling through external service integrations.

AI also supports my day-to-day engineering practice. I regularly use Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex for codebase exploration, implementation, debugging, and architectural planning, while keeping technical decisions and validation grounded in the product and its constraints.
